metadata.title: SlotMate — Multi-Tenant Appointment Scheduling
metadata.description: Mobile-first Progressive Web App powered by Supabase Auth, live user profiles, and isolated business workspaces.

hero.title: Organize businesses and time slots in real time.
hero.subtitle: SlotMate connects Supabase Auth, user profiles, and multi-tenant workspaces protected by Postgres Row Level Security.
